entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: Bloodchief of the Ghet vampire family of Malakir on Zendikar, who submitted his family to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ghet
entities.description: The poorest and least powerful vampire family of Malakir.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: Last bloodchief after the Eldrazi's defeat.

entities.name: Nimana
entities.description: Port city seized by the Ghet.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose thralls Kalitas made of the Ghet.

events.summary: The Ghet seized holdings outside Malakir, including Nimana, and Kalitas submitted his family to servitude beneath the Eldrazi.
events.quote: she couldn't prevent Kalitas from submitting his own family to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Drana was proclaimed the last bloodchief and Kalitas is presumed dead.
events.quote: As Drana is proclaimed to be the last bloodchief after the defeat of the Eldrazi, Kalitas is presumably dead.

relations.quote: Kalitas ( /kɑːlitɑːs/, KAHL-ee-tahss ) was the bloodchief of the Ghet

relations.note: Submitted his family to servitude beneath them.
relations.quote: she couldn't prevent Kalitas from submitting his own family to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi.
